_comment: Task 1.8 (rimward). Tarn far out from a bright white star; rings at 150,000 to 250,000 km.

systems.name: Tarn
systems.notes: Bright white star. Tarn orbits far out and stays cold, but its rings catch enough light to be seen from neighboring stars.
systems._comment: Star kind not given in the documents (R7, D16).

bodies.name: Tarn
bodies.class: cold rocky planet with very broad rings

lattice.where: Grains and lumps locked in the ring ice

bodies.notes: A cold rocky planet circled by rings broad enough to pick out by telescope from neighboring stars. Inside the rings, hidden by ice and debris, lie the ruins of an Absent shipyard. With four lane mouths, Tarn is one of the busiest junctions in the rimward arm.

bodies.name: Tarn's rings
bodies.class: ring system of ice and debris
bodies.notes: Lattice is locked into the ice of the rings as grains and small lumps that have to be melted out. The Ringwreckers live here and know the ice fields better than any survey team.
bodies.gmNotes: Some Ringwreckers sell Absent components to Smith-Shimano, which has never admitted buying them.

bodies.name: The Tarn yards
bodies.notes: Cradles and gantries kilometers long inside the rings, most of them broken, some still holding the frames of things that were never finished. Found in 5025u; only a fraction has been surveyed. The Basin Office, Smith-Shimano and the Ringwreckers are fighting over them, in the courts and in the rings.

bodies.name: Basin Office survey station
bodies.notes: One of the IPS-N Basin Office's survey stations in the rings, guarded by part of a force of about a thousand. The Ringwreckers attack them regularly.

bodies.name: Rimelight receiving station
bodies.notes: Where Rimelight's ore arrives from the Hollows, six days down a one-way lane, before going on to Scald and the Assay House.

bodies.name: Ringwreckers' hold (WIP)
bodies.notes: Where the Ringwreckers go when boarding crews come, and where they come back from once the crews have gone.

bodies.name: Smith-Shimano salvage tender (WIP)
bodies.notes: Smith-Shimano's presence in the rings, small and well armed.

bodies.name: Scald mouth
bodies.notes: Mouth of the 3-day lane to Scald.

bodies.name: Mire mouth
bodies.notes: Mouth of the 7-day lane to the Mire (drifting: its exit point wanders and a recent chart is needed).

bodies.name: The Sable Run mouth
bodies.notes: Mouth of the 12-day lane to Sable (drifting: its exit point wanders and a recent chart is needed). The Tarn end of the Sable Run.

bodies.name: Hollows mouth
bodies.notes: Mouth of the 6-day lane to the Hollows (one way, inward to here). Rimelight's ore arrives here.

places.name: Survey base camp (WIP)
places.notes: Basin Office ground camp beneath the rings.

places.name: Ice-core camp (WIP)
places.notes: Survey camp drilling through Lethe's frozen ocean toward the remains of the life beneath.
